posts.title: Welcome to the Notes blog
posts.excerpt: Guides, release notes, and tips for getting more out of Notes by Mobile1X.
posts.body:
## Why this blog exists

Notes is built to stay out of your way. This blog is where we share the small things that make it faster to use — keyboard shortcuts, sync tips, organisation ideas — plus what changed in each release.

## What to expect

- **How-to videos** for Android, iOS, and Web, each under two minutes.
- **Written guides** for the workflows that don't fit in a short clip.
- **Release notes** whenever something ships.

Use the platform filter at the top of the [blog home](./) to see only what applies to the device you're on.

_This is a sample post. Delete it from the editor once you've published your own._
